text:
anya: quick heads-up — we're proposing a column-evolution for analytics.events to shrink route metadata (route_meta -> route_meta_v1 jsonb -> compact fields). want a safe read strategy before we write the new shape.

matt: +1. do we plan dual-write, view-adapter, or api-layer compatibility?

anya: leaning toward a read-adapter + adapter view so console can opt-in per-route. dual-write for a short window for ingestion services.

sanjay: can we avoid breaking historical queries? most dashboards do `events->'route_meta'->>'route_id'`. shrinking may remove nested path.

elaine: let's add a compatibility view. idea: keep `events` as-is but create `events_compat_v2` view exposing old keys mapped from compact fields. consoles query that view until rollout done.

matt: sketch SQL idea:
```sql
create view analytics.events_compat_v2 as
select id, ts, 
  coalesce(route_meta->>'route_id', compact_route_id::text) as route_id,
  -- other rewrites
  payload
from analytics.events_v2;
```
This keeps dashboard queries working.

anya: exact. and instrument the view with `pg_stat_statements` tags for monitoring.

kyle: how do we handle writes from producer libs? they need to emit compact fields and old json for the dual-write window. that's an SDK bump.

sanjay: propose: 2-phase producer change: 1) dual-write both shapes (old json + compact columns) behind `enable_compact_events` flag, 2) migrate consumers off the old path, 3) drop old json after 4w.

elaine: console rollout UX: add a per-org feature flag `console.events_column_migration` so we can canary a few large customers, and a global toggle for internal testing.

anya: telemetry list to track during canary:
- query latency for key dashboards (top10 queries)
- `500`/`4xx` rates from console queries
- `row_size` distributions
- ingestion error rate from producer libs
- backfill progress metrics

matt: need a plan for backfills. full backfill will be heavy on IO. recommend chunked backfill with low priority worker pools + opt-in rate limiting. also add `safe_point` so long-running jobs can resume.

sanjay: snippet for chunked updater:
```sql
-- pseudo
update analytics.events_v2 set compact_route_id = compute_compact(route_meta)
where compact_route_id is null
limit 10000; -- looped by worker
```
Use `updated_at` cursor to avoid hotspots.

kyle: console-side query hints: until we switch, prefer `events_compat_v2` for UI queries, use `EXPLAIN` on canary orgs to validate plans. we should prewarm `indexes` on compact columns.

elaine: also add an API-layer adapter: Redwood API can translate client queries requesting `route_meta.route_id` to use compatibility view if org not opted-in. this reduces breakage for non-console consumers.

devrel-bot: deploy-tracker: new migration job added to `analytics-migrations` CI -> JOB ID #4521. will post progress updates.

anya: rollback plan:
1) disable producer dual-write -> producers fall back to old shape
2) switch console to `events_compat_v2` view (already default)
3) restore dropped columns from backup snapshot if we pruned them (last resort)

matt: one more risk: index bloat during backfill. we should create indexes concurrently and monitor `pg_repack` need.

sanjay: agree. also validate S3 export pipelines (reports expect old json). add shim that writes old json to export if org not opted-in.

anya: action items:
- eng-platform: create `events_compat_v2` view PR and index recommendations (matt)
- infra: provision low-priority worker queue + run backfill job template (kyle)
- console: add feature flag + opt-in UI for canary orgs (elaine)
- ingestion: prepare SDK dual-write and feature toggle (sanjay)
- telemetry: add dashboards for the metrics above and alert on regression (anya)

matt: timeline suggestion: prototype view + backfill dry-run in staging this week, canary next week, full rollout in 3w if no regressions.

elaine: LGTM. I'll draft the console flag UI copy and a short migration doc for support.

anya: thanks all. I'll create the tracking ticket and ping infra for the worker pool. if anyone has objections speak now, otherwise we'll move to PRs. :thumbsup:

kyle: no objections. posting links to migration-checklist template: https://redwood.internal/docs/migration-checklist

devrel-bot: CI update: PR created - analytics/events-compat-view (#2389) - checks queued.

matt: cool — will open the backfill job draft after lunch.

sanjay: note for oncall: add synthetic test hitting `events_compat_v2` every 5m during canary to detect regressions early.

anya: added to the checklist. closing thread after PR lands.
